platform: Cloud SaaS and browser-based ERP/SIS; institution-specific Android and iOS apps; five-year license option with separate hosting setup.

distinctive_features.feature: AI student assistant, natural-language reporting, enrollment bot, document verification, and retention-risk prediction.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: These tools may automate student support and operational analysis beyond conventional ERP dashboards.

distinctive_features.feature: More than 800 vendor-claimed customizable dashboards and reports, including AI-powered reporting.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Broad reporting can help institutions analyze admissions, fees, attendance, performance, and multi-campus operations.

distinctive_features.feature: Public REST API with documented admissions, finance, student, and faculty operations.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Documented endpoints give institutions a concrete route to integrate external systems and access records.

distinctive_features.feature: Attendance capture through mobile entry, QR, RFID, and biometric integrations.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Multiple capture methods let institutions align attendance workflows with different campus settings.

distinctive_features.feature: Configurable workflows, forms, and rules with low/no-code customization.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can adapt processes without relying entirely on custom software development.

distinctive_features.feature: Five-year upfront license option alongside annual SaaS subscriptions.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: The alternative commercial model gives buyers a choice beyond recurring SaaS subscriptions.

distinctive_features.feature: Institution-branded Android and iOS apps with module availability varying by institution.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can offer mobile access tailored to their selected deployment and user groups.

weaknesses.issue: Public prices are quote-only; directory listings showing ₹1 per year are placeholders, not usable quotes.
Users report occasional bugs, slow loading, and slower-than-needed fixes.
Reviewers report limited reporting flexibility and slow dynamic reports.
Reviewers describe customization as time-consuming and learning as difficult.
Reviews cite a dated interface and limited student-mobile features.
One older reviewer reported severe implementation failure and promised customization not delivered.
Public evidence does not confirm UDISE+, APAAR, board-specific cards, or NEP progress-card reporting.
SOC 2 status is inconsistently described as compliant and still in progress.
Public evidence does not confirm OneRoster, LTI, Ed-Fi, SIF, or SSO support.

pricing_model_summary: Annual per-user SaaS subscription or five-year upfront license, usually volume-based, with fixed annual maintenance from year two; prices and implementation fees are unpublished.
biggest_strategic_gap: Limited public evidence for Indian statutory reporting, board-specific workflows, DPDP readiness, and certified education interoperability standards.
